source_snapshot.title: Jesse Minter's Updates on Ravens Quarterback Injuries
source_snapshot.facts: Lamar Jackson to injured reserve after right-thumb injury; Tyler Huntley has toe injury; Joe Fagnano has an injury and was estimated limited in Monday walkthrough; coach said Fagnano has a chance to play Thursday; no healthy QB on 53-man roster at time of report.

source_snapshot.title: Ravens Snap Count Analysis, Week 8: Quarterback position in flux
source_snapshot.facts: Week 8 snaps: Fagnano 40, Huntley 10, Jackson 1; Henry 23, Justice Hill 25; Flowers 42, Bateman 39, Mark Andrews 29. Flowers five targets, zero catches; Bateman one catch; Andrews led TE snaps.

source_snapshot.title: 2026 NFL Position Roles - Jacksonville Jaguars
source_snapshot.facts: Last 3 played games (Weeks 5,6,8): Parker Washington 7.3 targets and 74% snaps; Jakobi Meyers 5.3 targets and 71% snaps, hamstring/ankle issues before Week 8; Brian Thomas 2.3 targets and 41% snaps; Brenton Strange 5.7 targets and 70% snaps.

source_snapshot.title: Jacksonville Jaguars Week 8 snap counts
source_snapshot.facts: Week 8 offensive snaps: Lawrence 44; Washington 36 (67%); Meyers 29 (54%); Strange 28 (52%); Thomas 28 (52%); Tuten 27 (50%); Rodriguez 12 (22%).

source_snapshot.title: Jacksonville Jaguars Depth Chart
source_snapshot.facts: Nov 3 roster snapshot: Lawrence starting QB; Tuten and Rodriguez listed questionable; Washington, Meyers, Thomas and Strange starters; Meyers questionable; Ezra Cleveland questionable; Anton Harrison on injured reserve.

source_snapshot.title: NFL Injury Report - AP
source_snapshot.facts: Week 9 initial injury report: JAX Tuten DNP ankle/foot; Meyers limited hamstring/ankle; Cleveland limited knee/ankle; Rodriguez limited hand. BAL Jackson DNP right thumb; Huntley DNP toe; Fagnano limited ankle; Henry not listed; Andrews full with hand.

source_snapshot.title: 2026 NFL Defense Rankings: Team Pass and Rush Stats
source_snapshot.facts: Through Week 8: Ravens allow 228.2 passing yards/game (21st); Jaguars allow 77.4 rushing yards/game (1st); Ravens allow 102.8 rushing yards/game (13th).

source_snapshot.title: Baltimore Ravens Stats
source_snapshot.facts: Through Week 8: Henry 158 carries, 632 rushing yards, 8 rushing TD; Zay Flowers 40 catches, 608 yards; Bateman 19 catches, 288 yards; Andrews 29 catches, 218 yards. Fagnano 10/21 for 91 yards, 1 INT.

source_snapshot.title: Jaguars at Ravens Weather Forecast — November 5, 2026
source_snapshot.facts: Baltimore kickoff forecast about 66-68°F, light winds 2-4 mph, low precipitation; expected weather impact negligible.

source_snapshot.title: Jaguars official depth chart
source_snapshot.facts: Official depth chart lists Lawrence, Washington, Thomas, Meyers and Strange as starters; Tuten and Rodriguez are listed as co-starters.

source_snapshot.title: Ravens official depth chart
source_snapshot.facts: Official depth chart lists Henry, Flowers, Bateman and Andrews as starters; Lamar Jackson is not the active starting QB listed in this chart.
